comment: Reviewed intent source for the fiveArm corpstable channel. No timestamps and no connection_material_base64: the ephemeral publish generator stamps deterministic material and the one-hour availability window at publish time. distribution.origins (XCFG-D06) advertises snapshot failover/migration origins inside the signed statement; append real mirrors here when they are deployed. Clients merge dev override, advertised origins, then package-baked anchors, so the channel self-origin is a harmless redundant anchor.
